summary: Archer's arrows quelled by hermit's wisdom Renuka's feet welcoming rest from sun's heat rather than suffer a husband's aim at a "friend of all who cause the noise who sets in motion the luminous one" #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Archer's arrows
quelled
by
hermit's wisdom
Renuka's feet
welcoming rest
from sun's heat
rather than suffer a
husband's aim
at a "friend of all
who cause the noise
who sets in motion
the luminous one"
#poetryport
